locks.intervention: sequential gated lock depth L (horizon H = L + 1) with anti-shaped live step cost, 3-lane diffusing dead sink, and opposing decoy lock in bidirectional_lock; useful returns and diagnostic KL fixed across L

epistasis.intervention: pleiotropic passenger modules k in {0,1,2,3} alongside 1-in-128 rare synthetic-rescue epistatic subtype: adds k high-MI zero-value passenger-omics channels and 4^k - 1 zero-KL aberrant pleiotropic knockouts

gi_screen.data: Horlbeck et al. 2018 Cell, K562 CRISPRi gene-level GI map (Mendeley 10.17632/rdzk59n6j4.1, GI_map_treeview.zip sha256 d389b3eb...f9115)
gi_screen.panel_rule: ceac_gi.data.select_panel(size=10, strong=-5.0, background_floor=-2.5, seed=2018): FDPS-PPP2R1A GI=-5.24, all other 44 pairs > -2.5
gi_screen.intervention: k in {0,1,2,3} panel genes with unknown SYNTHETIC main-effect bits revealed by single knockouts; GI-scored rewards make them decision-irrelevant. Assay noise sigma=1.25, hit threshold -3, assay floor 0.01, profiling halfwidth 0.04 are declared, not estimated.
gi_screen.frozen_before_outcomes: halfwidth 0.04 chosen from the episode-0 IDS allocation check only; no learning outcomes inspected

notes: Easy-case calibration (L=1 for locks, k=0 for epistasis) checks both tasks 0 and 1 on independent seeds 1001 and 1002.
Combination Lock and Bidirectional Lock share the identical L=1 easy baseline.
Primary CEAC uses Section-3 reward critic, price-conditioned evidence critic, and policy-labeled replay with coordinate-free row dominance and public confounder-equivalence reference certification.
ceac_natural evaluates the registered guarded natural/mirror actor extension from ceac_stability under the identical replay and two-critic loop.
ids_product receives the identical candidate model class and uniform full-support prior as CEAC; ids_decoy and ids_canonical test restricted biological/historical priors.
